name: table_lookup_family
source:
{ The row/cell accessor family over a TABLE: NLookupRows, Lookup, LookupRow and
  Differentiate. Java CodeTableTest.lookupCellAndRowCountAndRow and
  differentiateTableColumn: n = 3, c = 400, r = 2.5, d = 50. }
TABLE g(x)
  10   100
  20   400
  30   900
END
n = NLookupRows('g')
c = Lookup('g', 2, 2)
r = LookupRow('g', 1, 25)
d = Differentiate('g', 2, 1, 25)
